bake the baby script 🔥
does the annoying stuff for you lol
- auto catch babies + return to your spot
- auto oven delivery + occupied oven detection
- auto save teammates
- auto queue for 1v1 through 5v5
- role detection + baby hiding
- server hop with automatic resume
- speed, jump, fly, noclip and enemy esp
- anti afk, low graphics and disable 3d rendering
recommended: put it in your executor’s auto execute folder so it loads when you join. it only runs in bake the baby.
O = catch, R = save, L = oven, H = stop
server hop resume needs file access + teleport queue support. still updating it so some stuff might be buggy 👍
